name: Asher Ghioto
strengths: Ghioto plays with true 6-5 length off the edge and keeps tackles from latching his chest on the arc.
Ghioto has early mass (listed 240) to set the edge versus the run while still flashing pass-rush burst.
Ghioto finishes pursuit with violence and does not quit on second effort once the QB scrambles.
weaknesses: Ghioto still needs a deeper pass-rush counter package beyond length and power once tackles sit on his first move.
comparison: Ghioto comps to Brian Burns — 6-5 EDGE mold with length to win the arc and enough early mass to set the edge while the rush plan grows.
projection: Ghioto projects as a Year 2 SEC starter at EDGE (package rushes Year 1). Ceiling: All-SEC edge rusher — the length-and-power JACK who can win the arc and hold the edge every down.
schemeFit: Ghioto fits Brad White 3-3-5 JACK / wide-9 EDGE who attacks the arc with bend and burst while holding the edge in run support.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-08-04 from On3 profile Hudl embed. Comp size-matched within ~1–2" — not a Florida-alum default.

angle: Lead with 6-5 / 240 Bolles EDGE length + mass on the soph Hudl, then Florida chase heat.
